title: SSC CGL 2025 – Polity: Important Constitutional Amendments

questions.question:
Which Constitutional Amendment reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years?
किस संविधान संशोधन ने मतदान की आयु 21 से घटाकर 18 वर्ष की?
questions.solution: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 reduced voting age from 21 to 18. Frequently asked in SSC CGL to test exact amendment numbers.

questions.question:
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment is often called the 'Mini Constitution'. Which Prime Minister's government enacted it?
42वें संविधान संशोधन को 'लघु संविधान' कहा जाता है। इसे किस प्रधानमंत्री की सरकार ने अधिनियमित किया?
options: Lal Bahadur Shastri / लाल बहादुर शास्त्री
questions.solution: 42nd Amendment (1976) was enacted during Indira Gandhi's government. It added 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble. Most important amendment for SSC CGL.

questions.question:
Which amendment added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
किस संशोधन ने भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना में 'समाजवादी', 'पंथनिरपेक्ष' और 'अखंडता' शब्द जोड़े?
questions.solution: 42nd Amendment (1976) modified the Preamble. This is a top-repeated SSC CGL question — 'Secular', 'Socialist', 'Integrity' all added together in 1976.

questions.question:
The Right to Property was removed from Fundamental Rights and made a legal right by which amendment?
संपत्ति के अधिकार को मूल अधिकारों से हटाकर कानूनी अधिकार किस संशोधन द्वारा बनाया गया?
questions.solution: 44th Amendment (1978) removed Right to Property from Part III (Fundamental Rights) and made it a constitutional right under Article 300A. Critical SSC CGL topic.

questions.question:
Which amendment inserted the Fundamental Duties (Article 51A) in the Indian Constitution?
किस संशोधन ने भारतीय संविधान में मूल कर्तव्य (अनुच्छेद 51A) जोड़े?
questions.solution: 42nd Amendment (1976) added Part IVA (Article 51A) with 10 Fundamental Duties based on Swaran Singh Committee recommendations. SSC CGL frequently links 42nd Amendment to multiple changes.

questions.question:
The Anti-Defection Law was introduced by which Constitutional Amendment?
दल-बदल विरोधी कानून किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा प्रस्तुत किया गया?
questions.solution: 52nd Amendment (1985) introduced the 10th Schedule (Anti-Defection Law). Added during Rajiv Gandhi's government. Frequently tested in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
Which Constitutional Amendment granted Constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions?
किस संविधान संशोधन ने पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया?
questions.solution: 73rd Amendment (1992) added Part IX and 11th Schedule, giving constitutional status to Panchayats. 74th Amendment did the same for Urban Local Bodies. A classic SSC trap — both 73rd and 74th are asked.

questions.question:
The 74th Constitutional Amendment relates to which institution?
74वाँ संविधान संशोधन किस संस्था से संबंधित है?
options: Urban Local Bodies / शहरी स्थानीय निकाय
questions.answer: Urban Local Bodies / शहरी स्थानीय निकाय
questions.solution: 74th Amendment (1992) added Part IX-A and 12th Schedule for Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities). 73rd = Panchayats, 74th = Municipalities — classic SSC CGL confusion trap.

questions.question:
Which amendment lowered the age for election to Lok Sabha and State Assemblies to 25 years? (Note: It also revised emergency provisions)
किस संशोधन ने लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभाओं में चुनाव लड़ने की आयु 25 वर्ष निश्चित की?
questions.solution: 44th Amendment (1978) also revised Emergency provisions and restored rights diluted by 42nd Amendment. The age for candidacy to Lok Sabha/State Assembly (25) was already in original constitution — trap question testing 44th vs 42nd.

questions.question:
Which Constitutional Amendment added the 11th Schedule related to Panchayats?
किस संविधान संशोधन ने पंचायतों से संबंधित 11वीं अनुसूची जोड़ी?
questions.solution: 73rd Amendment added the 11th Schedule listing 29 subjects for Panchayats. 74th Amendment added the 12th Schedule (18 subjects) for Municipalities.

questions.question:
Which amendment inserted a new 11th fundamental duty — to provide opportunities for education to children between 6–14 years?
किस संशोधन ने 6-14 वर्ष के बच्चों को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करने का नया 11वाँ मूल कर्तव्य जोड़ा?
questions.solution: 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A (Right to Education), modified Article 45, and added the 11th Fundamental Duty. SSC CGL frequently asks about the 86th Amendment and Article 21A.

questions.question:
Right to Education (Article 21A) for children aged 6–14 was inserted by which amendment?
6-14 वर्ष के बच्चों के लिए शिक्षा का अधिकार (अनुच्छेद 21A) किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया?
questions.solution: 86th Amendment (2002) inserted Article 21A making education a Fundamental Right. This is one of the highest-frequency SSC CGL questions on amendments.

questions.question:
Which amendment capped the size of the Council of Ministers at 15% of the total strength of the House?
किस संशोधन ने मंत्रिपरिषद के आकार को सदन की कुल सदस्य संख्या के 15% तक सीमित किया?
questions.solution: 91st Amendment (2003) capped the Council of Ministers at 15% of the House's strength and also strengthened the Anti-Defection Law. Commonly confused with 52nd Amendment in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
Which amendment provided reservation for OBCs in central educational institutions along with SCs and STs?
किस संशोधन ने केंद्रीय शिक्षण संस्थाओं में SC/ST के साथ OBC को भी आरक्षण प्रदान किया?
questions.solution: 93rd Amendment (2005) enabled reservation for OBCs in central and state government aided private educational institutions. Important for SSC CGL — often confused with 86th Amendment.

questions.question:
The 97th Constitutional Amendment is related to which sector?
97वाँ संविधान संशोधन किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
options: Urban Local Bodies / शहरी स्थानीय निकाय
questions.solution: 97th Amendment (2011) gave constitutional status to co-operative societies, added Article 43B (DPSP) and Part IX-B. Frequently asked in recent SSC CGL exams.

questions.question:
Which amendment introduced the concept of Goods and Services Tax (GST) in the Constitution?
किस संशोधन ने संविधान में वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) की अवधारणा प्रस्तुत की?
questions.solution: 101st Amendment (2016) introduced GST, subsuming multiple central and state taxes. It added Article 246A and established GST Council. High-frequency recent SSC CGL topic.

questions.question:
The National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) was given constitutional status by which amendment?
राष्ट्रीय पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग (NCBC) को किस संशोधन द्वारा संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया?
questions.solution: 102nd Amendment (2018) gave constitutional status to NCBC under Article 338B. Frequently tested in SSC CGL 2023-2025 exams.

questions.question:
Which amendment provided 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in jobs and education?
किस संशोधन ने आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों (EWS) को नौकरियों और शिक्षा में 10% आरक्षण प्रदान किया?
questions.solution: 103rd Amendment (2019) added Article 15(6) and Article 16(6) to provide 10% EWS reservation. One of the most current and important amendments for SSC CGL 2025.

questions.question:
Which amendment extended the reservation for SC/ST in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 10 more years (up to 2030)?
किस संशोधन ने लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभाओं में SC/ST के लिए आरक्षण 10 और वर्षों (2030 तक) के लिए बढ़ाया?
questions.solution: 104th Amendment (2020) extended SC/ST seat reservation in Parliament and State Assemblies till 2030 and removed Anglo-Indian reservation. Critical recent amendment for SSC CGL 2025.

questions.question:
The 99th Constitutional Amendment, which was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2015, was related to:
99वाँ संविधान संशोधन, जिसे 2015 में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने निरस्त कर दिया, किससे संबंधित था?
options: National Judicial Appointments Commission / राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक नियुक्ति आयोग
questions.answer: National Judicial Appointments Commission / राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक नियुक्ति आयोग
questions.solution: 99th Amendment (2014) established NJAC to replace the collegium system for judicial appointments. SC struck it down in 2015. Tested in SSC CGL to check awareness of recent constitutional events.

questions.question:
Which amendment transferred Berubari Union territory to Pakistan, making it the first amendment to affect India's territory?
किस संशोधन ने बेरुबारी संघ क्षेत्र को पाकिस्तान को हस्तांतरित किया?
questions.solution: 9th Amendment (1960) gave effect to the transfer of Berubari Union to Pakistan as part of the Nehru-Noon Pact. Tests knowledge of early amendments in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
Which Constitutional Amendment added Sindhi language to the 8th Schedule?
किस संविधान संशोधन ने 8वीं अनुसूची में सिंधी भाषा जोड़ी?
questions.solution: 21st Amendment (1967) added Sindhi as the 15th language to the 8th Schedule. SSC CGL often asks about which amendment added which language — Sindhi = 21st is a key fact.

questions.question:
Which amendment added Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali to the 8th Schedule?
किस संशोधन ने 8वीं अनुसूची में कोंकणी, मणिपुरी और नेपाली भाषाएँ जोड़ीं?
questions.solution: 71st Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali to the 8th Schedule, taking the total to 18 languages. Later 92nd Amendment added 4 more (Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali) = 22 languages.

questions.question:
Which amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali to the 8th Schedule, making the total 22 languages?
किस संशोधन ने 8वीं अनुसूची में बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली और संताली जोड़कर कुल 22 भाषाएँ कीं?
questions.solution: 92nd Amendment (2003) added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali, taking scheduled languages from 18 to 22. SSC CGL regularly asks 'how many scheduled languages' and 'which amendment'.

questions.question:
The 1st Constitutional Amendment (1951) was primarily aimed at:
1वाँ संविधान संशोधन (1951) मुख्यतः किस उद्देश्य से लाया गया?
options: Abolishing Zamindari system / जमींदारी प्रथा उन्मूलन
Adding Sindhi to 8th Schedule / 8वीं अनुसूची में सिंधी जोड़ना
Reducing voting age / मतदान आयु घटाना
questions.answer: Abolishing Zamindari system / जमींदारी प्रथा उन्मूलन
questions.solution: 1st Amendment (1951) added the 9th Schedule to protect land reform laws (including Zamindari abolition laws) from judicial review. Tests knowledge of early and foundational amendments.

questions.question:
Which amendment added the 9th Schedule to the Constitution to protect certain laws from judicial review?
किस संशोधन ने न्यायिक समीक्षा से कुछ कानूनों को बचाने के लिए 9वीं अनुसूची जोड़ी?
questions.solution: 1st Amendment (1951) added the 9th Schedule and Article 31B to protect land reform laws from being struck down on the basis of Fundamental Rights violation.

questions.question:
The Balwantrai Mehta Committee recommendations led to which Constitutional development?
बलवंतराय मेहता समिति की सिफारिशों से कौन सा संवैधानिक विकास हुआ?
questions.solution: The Balwantrai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended democratic decentralisation. Its recommendations ultimately led to the 73rd Amendment (1992) giving constitutional status to Panchayati Raj. Conceptual SSC CGL trap.

questions.question:
Which amendment is associated with the 100th land exchange deal between India and Bangladesh?
किस संशोधन का संबंध भारत-बांग्लादेश के बीच 100वें भूमि विनिमय समझौते से है?
questions.solution: 100th Amendment (2015) gave effect to the Land Boundary Agreement (LBA) between India and Bangladesh. Directly relates to territorial changes. Important for recent SSC CGL awareness questions.

questions.question:
Which amendment gave Delhi the status of a Union Territory with a Legislature?
किस संशोधन ने दिल्ली को विधायिका सहित केंद्र शासित प्रदेश का दर्जा दिया?
questions.solution: 69th Amendment (1991) designated Delhi as the National Capital Territory (NCT) and gave it a Legislative Assembly and a Council of Ministers under Article 239AA. Frequently asked in SSC CGL.

questions.question:
The Swaran Singh Committee recommendations were implemented through which Constitutional Amendment?
स्वर्ण सिंह समिति की सिफारिशें किस संविधान संशोधन के माध्यम से लागू की गईं?
questions.solution: 42nd Amendment (1976) implemented Swaran Singh Committee recommendations, particularly on Fundamental Duties. The committee also suggested changes to the Preamble. High-value SSC CGL connection question.
